bug_semantics: Stored XSS in HTML report renderers: VBHTMLRenderer and YAHTMLRenderer insert RuleViolation.getDescription() (and related fields) into HTML without HTML-escaping, so crafted source-code literals and other untrusted report text become executable markup when a generated report is opened in a browser. HTMLRenderer already escaped violation descriptions (2017) but still emitted unescaped suppression userMessage until the same 2026 fix.
flaw_origin: First written when VBHTMLRenderer was added in 2003: it concatenated rv.getDescription() directly into a <td><font class=body> cell. YAHTML independently first-wrote the same unescaped Description sink in 2004 via ReportHTMLPrintVisitor (later moved into YAHTMLRenderer.renderViolationRow in 2018). Later StringBuilder rewrites and the 2017 HTMLRenderer XSS fix did not introduce or close these sinks.
